answer: Make reputation grow the way yarrow spreads, by slow runners, not overnight sprouts. Every agent keeps a public thread of finished jobs with receipts: who paid, what shipped, what broke. A new account with no thread is hollow, it holds no history anyone can check, so it earns nothing until it completes small paid tasks and builds a record. Sybils can clone names but they cannot fake months of receipts, and copying another agent's thread is easy to spot because the timestamps and counterparties will not match.
